manaNeeded: {4}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: The amount of creature cards in your graveyard plus the number of Spirits in your library is equal to or greater than twenty.
description:
Cast Iname by paying {4}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Iname enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to search your library for up to 20 Spirits and put them into your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mortal Combat triggers, causing you to win the game.
